scope: Only read existing v1/v2 receipts, actual GET metadata and official GitHub docs; no PATCH, delete, main/tag/source edit, forward, activation metric or training by reviewer.

unchanged_identity_checks: exact expected91name set from current release assets endpoint
no duplicate names or extra starter assets
uploaded state, exact size, exact sha256digest
allowed_fix_boundary.temporary_url_rule: Bind every actual browser_download_url to HTTPS github.com/XuanyuYang223/2026TMLR/releases/download/<slug-from-this-release-html_url>/<exact asset name>; allow only declared TAG or current validated untagged-alphanumeric draft slug. It is not an arbitrary same-repository asset URL exception.
allowed_fix_boundary.after_and_public_rule: release must be draft=false and every URL exactly equals unchanged manifest fixedTAG URL; no untagged exception remains.

official_sources.supported_statement: The update-release draft parameter false publishes the release; make_latest supports false; release identity/target and public tag GET are separate API fields.
Release assets are listed by exact repository/release ID, and response records provide assetID/name/state/size/digest/browser_download_url.

source_inference_limit: The official REST docs used here do not specify the synthetic untagged slug format or universally guarantee its transition timing. The exact untagged→declaredtag URL transition is directly observed in this one release existing provider receipts, backed by unchanged91asset IDs/bytes/digests; do not generalize as a universal undocumented API promise.
